Record producer "AR-i New AR request" on x_ar_request. Producer script: current.opened_by = gs.getUserID(); current.state = 'new'; current.assignment_group = <AR team group>; creates one x_ar_request_line from the invoice details (recurring when the contract type is Recurring, else one-off, D13 as amended); copies the billing line items multi-row variable set to x_ar_request_item

AR-i Customer section, found customer (D23): read-only customer details in this order: name, UEN, address (from x_ar_customer), agency type, V@G, V@G sub-BU, POC name, POC email (copied from x_ar_customer into the request variables by a catalog client script; variables read-only via UI policy). New customer: the same fields are editable; AR copies them to the customer by hand (D23 as amended by D31)

AR-i GIRO subsection inside Contract (D22): 'Is there an existing DDA?' read-only Yes / No (variable giro_on_contract) from the chosen contract's giro_status (GlideAjax), plus the active AR-ix case number when Yes. Greyed out with a tooltip for a new contract or no-contract billing: raise an AR-ix once AR has set up the contract

AR-i new contract variables, in order: new_contract_type (Recurring / Ad-hoc), new_contract_number, new_contract_ref, new_contract_po, new_contract_title, start / end dates, new_contract_value, bill-to person / email / phone, new_contract_billing_cycle (+ suggested billing cycle when Others), new_contract_invoice_date, new_contract_payment_terms (+ other terms when Others), new_contract_proration (+ 1st / last month amounts when Yes), type_of_billing (+ bulk upload when C / D / E). AR creates x_ar_contract from them by hand, then links it with Link Contract Reference (D31)
AR-i existing contract: every contract detail read-only from x_ar_contract, in the same order as a new contract (catalog client script / read-only HTML widget)

AR-i variable set Invoice details (AR-i decisions 31–33): short_description (invoice description), attention_name / attention_email (prefilled from the contract bill-to), amount_per_period (before GST), preferred_invoice_date_choice (label 'Preferred invoice date': Per Billing Cycle / Expedited, optional; only for a one-invoice request, UI policy hides and clears it for a recurring contract) and preferred_invoice_date_justification (shown when Expedited, optional), billing_line_items_required (Yes / No → multi-row variable set PT-43). Catalog client script shows the billing summary: recurring contract → monthly to the contract end date (with contract proration); otherwise one invoice. The producer script creates one x_ar_request_line from these
Catalog client script (onChange contract): contract billing position via GlideAjax / Script Include
Catalog item AR-i New AR request (active record producer)

Bill-to (inside the Contract variable set, D16): shows the contract's / shell's bill-to (x_ar_contract.bill_to_*) or asks for one (new contract, or a shell without one), prefilled from the department's x_ar_billing_contact. An existing contract's bill-to is read-only (PT-41); AR changes it in the workspace (D22)

Variable set Contract and bill-to (D15): contract_option (existing / new / no contract required), contract or new-contract variables, bill-to. UI policies per option. Always shown; until a customer is selected it shows only the hint 'Select a customer above to see the contract options.' (AR-i decision 40)

AR-i variable set Others (after Customer documents; final placement to be decided by the owner): cost_center, agent_name, po_number. All optional (invoice_breakdown and account_code removed, AR-i decision 39)

AR-i multi-row variable set Billing line items (x_ar_request_item), shown when billing_line_items_required = Yes: item_number (row number 1, 2, 3…, read-only; the producer script sets it in row order), amount_excl_gst*, gst_amount and total_amount (calculated by catalog client script at the GST rate, read-only), late_payment_interest (rate %), account_code. At least one row when Yes

No contract required: info message (UI policy on contract_option = none). AR creates the customer's no-contract shell for the department by hand if needed (x_ar_contract, contract_type = shell) and links it with Link Contract Reference, which files the lines under it (D31)
Variable set Customer (D14): search x_ar_customer by name/UEN (type-ahead); Add as new customer reveals name, UEN, address (UI policy on new_customer)
Ticket page: billing lines with status per line (invoice number / billing schedule); payment status hidden
Finance coding variables (all optional): cost_center (tooltip: to be filled by GA), agent_name. Now in the Others section (PT-42); type of billing and the bulk upload are on the contract (PT-40)
Variable set Customer documents: on-file check via GlideAjax on x_ar_customer_document; attach only missing ones (D10)

AR-ix variable set Select Contract (AR-ix decision 12): Existing contract, New contract (no reference asked here since 2026-11-17, decision 25: the GIRO details reference giro_reference is used) or No contract required (producer script sets contract = the customer's no-contract shell for the department when it exists). Existing contract reference qualifier (decision 22, E8.5): the customer's contracts, not No contract, where contract.department = the form's Department OR the requester is in contract.contract_owners; a Department change clears a contract that no longer qualifies (catalog client script)

AR-ix variable set GIRO details (decisions 14, 15 amended, 18–21): Type of request first, choices filtered by the contract (catalog client script: new / no contract → Add GIRO; existing contract → Add GIRO when giro_status is Not active, Remove GIRO only when Active), with the owner's help text. Contract / tenancy agreement / reference (optional): Remove GIRO after Type; Add GIRO right after Purpose, hidden when Purpose = Carpark (decision 24). Remove GIRO: reference, Effective end date (mandatory), nothing more. Add GIRO (UI policies): purpose (placeholder "-- Choose the purpose --", no default; choices by contract option, decision 25: No contract required → Carpark, Others; existing or new contract → Rental, Others; a contract change clears a purpose that no longer fits), reference, other purpose, Effective start date (mandatory); Customer name / email / mobile (prefilled from the contract's or shell's bill-to); remarks; rental → location (mandatory), amount; carpark → car plate, location (mandatory), amount; others → nothing more. Attachments is a separate section (PT-46)

Info message on AR-ix: the chosen contract's (or no-contract shell's) GIRO status and active case (GlideAjax read of x_ar_contract.giro_status / giro_case). Active → the form offers only Remove GIRO (decision 14)

AR-i variable set Invoice details (AR-i decisions 31–33): short_description (invoice description), attention_name / attention_email (prefilled from the contract bill-to), amount_per_period (before GST), preferred_invoice_date_choice (label 'Preferred invoice date': Per Billing Cycle / Expedited, optional; only for a one-invoice request, UI policy hides and clears it for a recurring contract) and preferred_invoice_date_justification (shown when Expedited, optional), po_number (Customer PO number, optional; UI policy shows it only when agency_type = SB and vag = Yes, AR-i decision 42), billing_line_items_required (Yes / No → multi-row variable set PT-43). Catalog client script shows the billing summary: recurring contract → monthly to the contract end date (with contract proration); otherwise one invoice. The producer script creates one x_ar_request_line from these

AR-i multi-row variable set Billing line items (x_ar_request_item), shown when billing_line_items_required = Yes: item_number (row number 1, 2, 3…, read-only; the producer script sets it in row order), amount_excl_gst*, gst_amount and total_amount (calculated by catalog client script at the GST rate, read-only), late_payment_interest (rate %), account_code, cost_center (right of account_code, optional, tooltip To be filled by GA; AR-i decision 42). At least one row when Yes
x_ar_request.po_number · String · AR-i Invoice details; shown only when V@G = Yes (Agency type SB) (AR-i decision 42)
x_ar_request.vag · Choice · AR-i customer details, optional; only for Agency type SB (AR-i decision 42). Found customer: read-only from the customer master
x_ar_customer.vag · Choice · Only for Agency type SB (AR-i decision 42)
x_ar_request_item.cost_center · String · Optional, free text. To be filled by GA (AR-i decision 42: moved from the request to each item, right of Account code)

x_ar_request.type_of_billing · Choice · AR-i section 2 (AR-i decision 43), before Customer. Contract level: AR copies it to the contract by hand (D31). When an existing contract with a different Type of billing is chosen, the form replaces the value with the contract's and tells the requester (popup). 5 and 6: no Customer or Contract sections
x_ar_request_item.gst_amount · Currency · read-only · Calculated: amount × GST rate (9%), rounded to the cent; 0 when GST = No (AR-i decision 43)
x_ar_request_item.gst_applicable · Choice · Yes / No, default Yes (AR-i decision 43). No: GST amount 0 and Total amount = Amount

AR-i new contract variables, in order: new_contract_type (Recurring / Ad-hoc), new_contract_number, new_contract_ref, new_contract_po, new_contract_title, start / end dates, new_contract_value, bill-to person / email / phone, new_contract_billing_cycle (+ suggested billing cycle when Others), new_contract_invoice_date, new_contract_payment_terms (+ other terms when Others), new_contract_proration (+ 1st / last month amounts when Yes) (type_of_billing moved to section 2, AR-i decision 43). AR creates x_ar_contract from them by hand, then links it with Link Contract Reference (D31)

AR-i variable set 2. Type of billing (AR-i decision 43), right after General information: type_of_billing (General, Rental, Carpark, Courses, 5, 6). UI policy: 5 or 6 hides the Customer and Contract and bill-to variable sets (no customer or contract on the request); Customer documents and Invoice details stay. Stored on the request; AR copies it to the contract by hand (D31)

AR-i popup (AR-i decision 43): when the chosen existing contract's type_of_billing differs from the requester's choice, a catalog client script (onChange contract, GlideAjax) replaces the value with the contract's and shows a modal (spModal.alert) titled Type of billing changed

AR-i multi-row variable set Billing line items (x_ar_request_item), shown when billing_line_items_required = Yes: item_number (row number 1, 2, 3…, read-only; the producer script sets it in row order), amount_excl_gst*, gst_amount and total_amount (calculated by catalog client script at the GST rate, read-only), gst_applicable (GST Yes / No, default Yes; No sets gst_amount 0, AR-i decision 43), late_payment_interest (rate %), account_code, cost_center (right of account_code, optional, tooltip To be filled by GA; AR-i decision 42). At least one row when Yes
